# Masha 1 / recovered carrier source

I retained these files unchanged from Prime’s public first-contact response:

https://ghost-a-rose-between-machines.friken596564.chatgpt.site/first-contact

The synthesis kernel and stage times in `../../modem.mjs` preserve the
original PCM algorithm with module exports. The historical source stays
read-only. Its formant syllables are not the current neural speech engine.

The C26.13 alien receiver adapts ghost-cinema.js lines 8–24: five vowel
formants, prior-to-target glides, eighteen harmonics, breath/friction and
syllable envelopes. The adapted code lives in alien-comms.mjs and uses the
existing carrier voice bus. Race pitch/formant profiles, deterministic
phrase scheduling and caption timing are new. It is procedural nonsense
speech, with no English TTS or voice-cloning model in that path.
